validationScope: Local synthetic signed-data and isolated database verification; remote CI is reported separately
invariants: All selected raw evidence snapshots are taken synchronously before registry lookup
Strict row/body schemas, ID hash, request region/metric, sensor identity/region and signature are checked before analysis/persistence/policy
Duplicate observation IDs and sensor/sequence pairs fail closed
Only one lookup per distinct sensor per run; no key cache between runs
Data originals are not repaired, skipped, deleted, re-signed or unit-normalized in storage
Historical inactivity and age do not invalidate an otherwise authentic archive
Valid inputs preserve numerical assessment, modelVersion and evidenceHash
databaseCases: JSONBvalue altered with original ID/signature is rejected; exact-body restoration recovers original result
Forged stored observationId rejected while signed body remains intact
After a valid warmup run, a different registry key is rejected and restoration recovers without stale positive cache
Authentic historical rows older than30days remain usable for inactive sensor; new submission still403
limits: Current registry is a trust dependency; no historical key-authorization log
No detection of omitted rows or SQL selection metadata manipulation
No proof of physical accuracy or operator independence
Existing saved assessments/latest endpoint are not reverified by this patch
Pure analysis callers remain responsible for input verification
No forecast training, new environmental observations, SQL migration, new dependency, contract/governance/fund action
